methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia lawmakers study AI risks and potential new regulations - WTVR.com
signals.signal_reading: State lawmakers studying AI risks and regulations suggests reactive policy posture rather than proactive capability-building, potentially creating compliance burdens without distributing AI literacy or infrastructure across regions.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce indicates metro concentration of AI adoption demands, likely deepening the capability gap between urban knowledge workers and rural communities without intentional distribution strategies.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Partnership with ed2go for on-demand workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals platform-delivered, shallow AI adoption—accessible but unlikely to build deep local capability without hands-on implementation support.

signals.title: Virginia’s AI Data Center Gravy Train Shows Signs of Slowing - Bloomberg Law News
signals.signal_reading: NoVA's data center growth slowing suggests potential saturation of infrastructure-layer AI concentration, but without evidence of capability diffusion to other regions, reinforces existing geographic inequality.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Generative AI’s content thirst, entrepreneur center opens in Blacksburg, state to fund EV charging infrastructure
signals.signal_reading: Entrepreneur center opening in Blacksburg (Virginia Tech corridor) creates infrastructure for peer-to-peer AI learning in a non-metro region, potentially seeding distributed deep capability if it connects to broader networks beyond the university.
